adjuster_notes: Insured reports burst supply line under kitchen sink on 15 Mar 2024. Water damage confined to kitchen cabinet base and vinyl flooring approx 12 sq ft. Plumber confirmed sudden failure of braided steel supply line, no evidence of prior leakage. Repair estimate $3,200. Deductible $1,500. Policy form HO-0304 ed 03-24.

Insured reports water staining on ceiling, estimated 6 months of slow drip from dishwasher supply hose. Continuous seepage confirmed, duration exceeds 14 consecutive days per CLAUSE WD-1 of HO-0304 ed 03-24. Exclusion E-11 applies. Claim denied. Deductible would have been $2,000.
denial_reason: Continuous seepage exceeding 14-day limit; not sudden and accidental

adjuster_notes: Named Storm Ian-2024 made landfall 10 May 2024 within 50 miles of insured property. Roof damage, partial collapse of north face. Claim valid under HO-0305 ed 03-24. Named Storm deductible applies per CLAUSE NS-2: greater of $5,000 or 2% Coverage A. Coverage A = $350,000 so deductible = $7,000. Adjuster recommends coverage confirmation pending final estimate.

Insured discovers black mold on basement drywall following confirmed sudden pipe burst on 18 Jun 2024. Mold remediation required. Under HO-0306 ed 04-24, CLAUSE MF-2 covers mold remediation costs when mold results from a sudden water discharge up to sublimit. Deductible $1,000 applies. Coverage confirmed for mold remediation portion.

Insured filed claim for mold found on exterior wood siding. Inspection shows mold growth consistent with long-term humidity exposure over multiple seasons, not from any sudden discharge. HO-0306 CLAUSE MF-4 excludes mold resulting from atmospheric humidity, condensation, or gradual water infiltration. E-22 exclusion applies. Claim denied.
denial_reason: Mold from long-term humidity, not sudden discharge

adjuster_notes: Insured claims air quality testing and mold sampling fees of $1,800 after mold discovered. Per HO-0306 CLAUSE MF-3, air quality testing and mold sampling costs are NOT covered under the endorsement. Only physical remediation is covered under MF-2. Claim for testing fees denied. Any covered remediation subject to $1,200 deductible.
denial_reason: Air quality testing excluded under CLAUSE MF-3

adjuster_notes: Insured reports earthquake tremors on 01 Sep 2024 causing cracked foundation and shifted framing. Per HO-0308 ed 05-24 CLAUSE EM-1, earthquake including tremors and aftershocks is excluded. E-31 covers earth movement broadly. Claim denied in full. No deductible applicable on denied claim.
denial_reason: Earth movement exclusion; earthquake expressly excluded under CLAUSE EM-1

adjuster_notes: Sinkhole collapse reported at insured property 15 Sep 2024. Per HO-0308 ed 05-24 exclusion table, E-33 covers sinkhole collapse under the earth movement exclusion group. Entire loss excluded. Deductible not applicable.
denial_reason: Sinkhole collapse excluded under E-33, earth movement

adjuster_notes: Pipe burst due to ground freeze caused by earth movement (subsidence). Two concurrent causes: earth movement (E-31, excluded) and resulting pipe burst (covered peril under base policy). HO-0308 CLAUSE EM-2 concurrent causation rule applies: entire loss excluded when earth movement acts with a covered peril. Claim denied.
denial_reason: Concurrent causation rule CLAUSE EM-2; earth movement + covered peril = full exclusion

adjuster_notes: Insured operates a home-based tax consulting service. Client injured on premises during appointment. Liability claim filed. HO-0309 ed 05-24 exclusion E-19 excludes business pursuits liability. Home-based income-generating activity qualifies as business pursuit. Claim denied. Deductible not relevant for denied liability.
denial_reason: Business pursuits exclusion E-19 under HO-0309

adjuster_notes: Home day care operator (licensed, 4 children) seeks liability coverage for child injury on premises. Per HO-0309 ed 05-24 CLAUSE BP-3, licensed home day care operations are excluded from business pursuits liability under E-19 when the day care meets state licensing criteria. Coverage denied. No deductible applicable.
denial_reason: Home day care liability excluded under CLAUSE BP-3, E-19

adjuster_notes: Insured reports mysterious disappearance of scheduled diamond ring (appraised $12,000, scheduled under HO-0307 ed 04-24). Scheduled items are covered for mysterious disappearance under HO-0307, unlike unscheduled items which carry exclusion E-28. Coverage confirmed for scheduled ring. Deductible $2,500.

Sudden supply line failure under bathroom vanity on 01 Dec 2024. Water reached hardwood floors in hallway. Damage confined to 40 sq ft. No prior seepage evidence. Policy HO-0304 ed 03-24 E-17 confirms burst supply line IS covered. Deductible $1,000. Estimate $4,800. Coverage confirmed.

Named Storm Brenda-2025 caused wind damage 10 Jan 2025. Insured's Coverage A = $280,000. Named Storm deductible per HO-0305 CLAUSE NS-2 is greater of $5,000 or 2% of $280,000 = $5,600. Policy deductible $500 does NOT apply; Named Storm deductible supersedes. Damage estimate $22,000. Coverage subject to $5,600 Named Storm deductible.

Insured's washing machine supply hose failed suddenly causing 3 inches of water in laundry room and adjacent bedroom. Sudden and accidental confirmed; hose failure was abrupt per plumber report. Duration of leakage before discovery was less than 1 hour, well within 14-day limit under CLAUSE WD-1 of HO-0304. Deductible $1,500. Coverage confirmed.

Mold discovered in attic after roof leak. Roof leak was sudden (storm damage confirmed). Mold remediation covered under HO-0306 MF-2 since cause was sudden water discharge from above. Air quality testing requested by insured - denied per MF-3. Physical mold remediation estimate $6,200 covered subject to $2,000 deductible.

Land subsidence caused separation of foundation from exterior wall. Insured requests coverage. HO-0308 ed 05-24 exclusion E-34 covers land subsidence as part of earth movement group. Claim denied. Deductible not applicable.
denial_reason: Land subsidence excluded under E-34, earth movement group

adjuster_notes: Insured runs Airbnb short-term rental on property. Guest injury claim. HO-0309 ed 05-24 exclusion E-36 excludes income-generating short-term rental activity from liability coverage. Airbnb rental income qualifies as business pursuit. Claim denied under E-36 and E-19.
denial_reason: Short-term rental income activity excluded under E-36 and E-19

adjuster_notes: Refrigerator water line failed suddenly, causing significant water damage to kitchen floor and lower cabinets. Sudden and accidental confirmed. Duration: approximately 2 hours before discovery. HO-0304 ed 03-24 covers this under supply line provisions. E-17 confirms coverage. Deductible $500 applies. Estimate $5,100.

Insured reports unscheduled gold necklace disappeared from home, value approximately $800. HO-0307 ed 04-24 exclusion E-28 excludes mysterious disappearance for unscheduled personal property. Necklace was not listed on scheduled items rider. Coverage denied under E-28.
denial_reason: Mysterious disappearance of unscheduled item excluded under E-28

adjuster_notes: Freelance graphic designer works from home studio, client property damaged during meeting. Liability claim. HO-0309 ed 05-24 E-19 business pursuits exclusion applies to freelance income activity. Coverage denied.
denial_reason: Freelance business activity excluded under E-19

adjuster_notes: Named Storm Clara-2025 hit property 15 Jun 2025. Coverage A value $420,000. Named Storm deductible per CLAUSE NS-2: 2% of $420,000 = $8,400 which exceeds $5,000 minimum, so $8,400 applies. Damage $31,000. Coverage subject to $8,400 Named Storm deductible.

Insured's hot water heater pressure relief valve discharged suddenly, flooding utility room. Sudden and accidental. HO-0304 supply line provisions apply. Duration under 1 hour. E-17 confirms coverage. Deductible $1,000. Coverage confirmed.
